Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Rod Strickland?

Rod Strickland is 59 years old.

Where was Rod Strickland born?

Rod Strickland was born in Bronx, New York.

When was Rod Strickland born?

Rod Strickland was born on July 11, 1966.

How tall is Rod Strickland?

Rod Strickland is 6-3 (190 cm) tall.

How much did Rod Strickland weigh when playing?

Rod Strickland weighed 175 lbs (79 kg) when playing.

Is Rod Strickland in the Hall of Fame?

Rod Strickland is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Rod Strickland drafted?

Rod Strickland was drafted by New York Knicks, 1st round (19th pick, 19th overall), 1988 NBA Draft.

What position did Rod Strickland play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

When did Rod Strickland retire?

Rod Strickland last played in 2005.

What is Rod Strickland's net worth?

Rod Strickland made at least $41,163,317 playing professional basketball.

How much did Rod Strickland make?

Rod Strickland made $10,000,000 in 2000.

What did Rod Strickland average?

Rod Strickland averaged 13.2 points, 3.7 rebounds, and 7.3 assists per game.

How many rings does Rod Strickland have?

Rod Strickland won 0 championships.

What schools did Rod Strickland attend?

Rod Strickland attended Truman in Bronx, New York, Oak Hill Academy in Mouth of Wilson, Virginia and DePaul.

What are Rod Strickland's nicknames?

Hot Rod, Lightning Rod are nicknames for Rod Strickland.
